title: festuca cinerea subsp. crassifolia
intro: Festuca cinerea subsp. crassifolia, commonly known as hard fescue, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is known to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and protect the skin and mucous membranes. The therapeutic actions of Festuca cinerea subsp. crassifolia include its ability to calm irritation and inflammation, making it useful for treating conditions such as eczema and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
